FocoTotal blocks distracting websites and apps on Windows 10/11 for a set time, on a weekly schedule or in Pomodoro cycles. Free and open source (MIT). The interface is in Portuguese.

O FocoTotal bloqueia sites e aplicativos que distraem no Windows 10/11, por tempo, por agenda semanal ou em ciclos de Pomodoro. Gratuito e de código aberto (MIT).

## Install / Instalar

Download `FocoTotal-{{VERSION}}-x64.msi` below and run it, or install silently:

```
msiexec /i FocoTotal-{{VERSION}}-x64.msi /qn
```

Uninstall: *Settings > Apps > FocoTotal > Uninstall* (when no locked block is running).

The changes FocoTotal makes to Windows are listed in the [README](https://github.com/rafaelfariasbsb/FocoTotal#alterações-que-o-focototal-faz-no-sistema) and shown when the app first runs. FocoTotal sends no data over the network.
